verdict.rationale: Mixpanel documents its own Feature Flags API that assigns users to variants for experiments, rollouts, and releases, and it publishes a Feature Flags OpenAPI spec, so the product directly ships feature flagging. The evidence never describes the targeting mechanics the story asks for. missing for 10: documented targeting by user properties, cohort-based flag targeting, percentage-rollout controls, SDK flag-evaluation docs, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can roll out features behind flags targeted by user properties, cohorts, and percentage rollouts

citations.quote: Use the Feature Flags API to assign your users to variants for experiments, rollout, and releases.
designing, running, and analyzing tests and rollouts in the same place you do all your analytics
